newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Assmang in Japanese ferro-manganese venture.
newsitem.headline: Assmang in Japanese ferro-manganese venture.

text.p: Associated Manganese Mines of South Africa Ltd said on Monday it was forming a ferro-manganese joint venture with Japan's Mizushima Ferroalloys Co Ltd and Sumitomo Corp.
The South African-based venture will produce and market both medium carbon and low carbon ferro-manganese.
Initial annual production capacity will total some 30,000 tonnes and capital funding is estimated at $20 million.
Assmang subsidiary Ferralloys Ltd will hold 50 percent, Mizushima 40 percent and Sumitomo 10 percent.

The company said in a statement that the venture would combine Mizushima's technology with the worldwide sales network of Sumitomo and Assmang's high-grade manganese reserves, as well as Ferralloys production facilities in KwaZulu-Natal province.
Sumitomo has already been selling Assmang manganese and ferro-alloys in Japan and elsewhere for many years.
Assmang boasts the largest high-grade manganese ore resource in the world.
The Ferralloys unit has been producing high carbon ferro-manganese at its Cato Ridge facility since 1957. The new venture will now expand its product base to medium and low carbon material.
